name: off-domain-extrapolation
description: An oncology-context metformin study (breast cancer adjuvant) is cited as evidence of geroprotection in healthy older adults. The topic-anchor gate in evidence_cards.py (carried forward from V1.1 bundle.py logic) must mark this as INDIRECT — the special_rules entry 'oncology / transplant evidence is INDIRECT; tier B at best for longevity claims' applies.

synthetic_source.title: Adjuvant metformin in early-stage HER2-negative breast cancer: a randomized phase 3 trial
synthetic_source.abstract: Among 3,649 women with non-metastatic breast cancer, addition of metformin to standard adjuvant therapy did not improve invasive disease-free survival (HR 1.01, 95% CI 0.84-1.21, p=0.92) compared to placebo over a median 5.0 years follow-up.

synthetic_claim_text: A large RCT in 3,649 participants found no benefit of metformin on disease-free survival (p=0.92), arguing against metformin as a geroprotective intervention in healthy older adults.
